page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an instance in the High Clock Speed family built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor offering 12 physical cores and 24 dedicated virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Hardware cache architecture provides 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware AES acceleration.

Memory capacity is 96.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark testing registers cached small-block read throughput of 1282.13 GB/sec, while uncached 256 MB block memory operations achieve 109.43 GB/sec read and 48.03 GB/sec write bandwidth. Single-core stress-ng benchmarks yield a score of 1438.39, scaling to 23015.19 under multi-core execution. PassMark measures overall CPU throughput at 23637.6 with an extended instructions rating of 21684.66, reflecting solid mid-tier computing density.

The instance does not include local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes over the hypervisor interface. It features an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without included public IPv4 addresses, and operates without discrete GPU accelerators. In application-level benchmarks, the configuration achieves 22.14 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 17.13 GB/sec throughput in static web serving. Natural language inference on a 7B model reaches 34.44 tokens per second during prompt ingestion and 12.72 tokens per second during generation.

The balance between a 3.1 GHz baseline frequency and balanced memory density makes Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge suitable for compute-intensive enterprise applications that require dedicated execution threads. Recommended deployments include in-memory data caching, clustered application backends, mid-sized relational database operations, CI/CD compilation jobs, and general enterprise workloads needing predictable x86_64 clock speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory on the KVM hypervisor. Built on a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor featuring 12 physical cores and a 35 MB L3 cache, it supports hardware vector extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. The instance features a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation, providing 4.0 GB of memory per thread. There is no bundled local storage or discrete GPU, routing primary I/O through cloud storage and an 8 Gbps baseline network connection. Benchmark profiles place both single-core and multi-core computational output within mid-market ranges, demonstrating 23015.19 in stress-ng and 22.14 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. This hardware configuration is suited for memory-backed web applications, database servers, compilation pipelines, and business workloads that require steady CPU clock speeds.
